8	/-!
9	# Krull dimension is at most embedding dimension — the `≤` half in cotangent currency
10	
11	## What this changes, and the measurement it corrects
12	
13	`Picard/Pic0Dimension.lean` states `dim Pic⁰_{C/k} = g` against a hypothesis
14	
15	```
16	hle : ∀ z, ringKrullDim (stalk z) ≤ (genus C : WithBot ℕ∞)
17	```
18	
19	and its docstring records that direction as **genuinely absent**, having measured
20	`Albanese/StandardSmoothDimension.lean` and found "only *lower* bounds, and only
21	at *maximal* ideals". That measurement was of the wrong quantity. It looked for a
22	bound on `ringKrullDim` in terms of a presentation; what the tangent-space leg of
23	this chapter actually produces is a **cotangent** dimension, and the passage from
24	one to the other is unconditional:
25	
26	```
27	ringKrullDim R ≤ dim_{κ} (m/m²)      for every Noetherian local ring R
28	```
29	
30	with **no regularity hypothesis and no condition on the residue field**. Both
31	halves are already in the pinned mathlib and neither was used in this project
32	(`spanFinrank` appears in exactly one AJC file, for an unrelated purpose):
33	
34	* `ringKrullDim_le_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal` — Krull's height theorem, in the form
35	  `dim R ≤ (minimal number of generators of m)`;
36	* `IsLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_finrank_cotangentSpace` — Nakayama,
37	  identifying that generator count with `dim_{κ(R)} (m/m²)`.
38	
39	Equality is the regular case (`IsRegularLocalRing.iff_finrank_cotangentSpace`), and
40	that is the *only* form the project had. The inequality is what a dimension **upper**
41	bound needs, and it holds everywhere.
42	
43	## Why this matters for the `PerfectField` binder
44	
45	`Pic0.genus_le_topologicalKrullDim_of_smooth` and
46	`Pic0.topologicalKrullDim_eq_genus_of_forall_ringKrullDim_stalk_le` both carry
47	`[PerfectField k]`, inherited from
48	`Scheme.isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_smooth_of_perfectField` — the only route this
49	tree has from smoothness to a regular stalk, and its upstream input
50	`isRegularLocalRing_of_isLocalization_atPrime_of_isStandardSmooth_of_perfectField`
51	carries `[PerfectField k]` in its own signature, so the binder is not removable
52	there. Under the standing owner decision (inbox I-0491) the Jacobian headline is
53	stated over an **arbitrary** field, so any `PerfectField` on this leg is a real
54	gap and not a stylistic one.
55	
56	The results below do **not** close that gap for the `≥` direction, and this file
57	claims nothing about it: `≥` genuinely needs regularity at the identity, because it
58	turns an embedding dimension into a *lower* bound on the Krull dimension and that
59	implication is false in general (a cusp has embedding dimension `2` and dimension
60	`1`). What they do is make the `≤` direction free of both `PerfectField` and
61	regularity — so of the two directions of `dim Pic⁰ = g`, the one previously called
62	"genuinely absent" is now the one with no side conditions at all.
63	
64	## Main results
65	
66	* `ringKrullDim_le_finrank_cotangentSpace` — the ring-level inequality.
67	* `Scheme.ringKrullDim_stalk_le_finrank_cotangentSpace` — at a scheme point.
68	* `Scheme.topologicalKrullDim_le_of_forall_finrank_cotangentSpace_le` — the `≤`
69	  half of a dimension computation, in cotangent currency, for any locally
70	  Noetherian scheme.
71	* `Scheme.topologicalKrullDim_eq_of_forall_finrank_cotangentSpace_le_of_regular` —
72	  the two halves combined: a uniform cotangent bound at every point plus a
73	  regular point where the cotangent dimension is exactly `d`.
74	-/
75	
76	universe u
77	
78	open AlgebraicGeometry Order IsLocalRing CategoryTheory
79	
80	/-- **The Krull dimension of a Noetherian local ring is at most its embedding
81	dimension** — `dim R ≤ dim_{κ(R)} (m/m²)`, with no regularity hypothesis and no
82	condition on the residue field.
83	
84	Two mathlib facts, composed:
85	
86	* `ringKrullDim_le_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal` (Krull's height theorem) bounds the
87	  dimension by the minimal number of generators of the maximal ideal;
88	* `IsLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_finrank_cotangentSpace` (Nakayama)
89	  identifies that count with the `κ(R)`-dimension of the cotangent space.
90	
91	Regularity is exactly the case of *equality*
92	(`IsRegularLocalRing.iff_finrank_cotangentSpace`), which is the only form this
93	project had; the inequality holds always, and it is the direction an upper bound on
94	dimension needs. The converse inequality is **false** without regularity — a cusp
95	`k[x,y]/(y²-x³)` localised at the origin has embedding dimension `2` and dimension
96	`1` — which is why the `≥` half of a dimension computation still needs a regular
97	point and this one does not. -/
98	theorem ringKrullDim_le_finrank_cotangentSpace
99	    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] :
100	    ringKrullDim R ≤ ((Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
101	  rw [← IsLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_finrank_cotangentSpace R]
102	  exact ringKrullDim_le_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal R
103	
104	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
105	
106	/-- **At a point of a locally Noetherian scheme, the stalk's Krull dimension is at
107	most its embedding dimension.** The scheme-level form of
108	`ringKrullDim_le_finrank_cotangentSpace`; the stalk of a locally Noetherian scheme
109	is a Noetherian local ring, which is the only instance input. -/
110	theorem ringKrullDim_stalk_le_finrank_cotangentSpace
111	    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (z : X) :
112	    ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk z)
113	      ≤ ((Module.finrank (ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk z))
114	            (CotangentSpace (X.presheaf.stalk z)) : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
115	  ringKrullDim_le_finrank_cotangentSpace _
116	
117	/-- **The `≤` half of a dimension computation, in cotangent currency.** If the
118	cotangent space at every point of a locally Noetherian scheme has dimension at most
119	`d`, then `dim X ≤ d`.
120	
121	This is the statement `Pic0.topologicalKrullDim_eq_genus_of_forall_ringKrullDim_stalk_le`
122	wanted and could not get from a presentation: it asks for a bound on the *same*
123	invariant the tangent-space leg computes, rather than on `ringKrullDim` directly, and
124	it needs no regularity anywhere. -/
125	theorem topologicalKrullDim_le_of_forall_finrank_cotangentSpace_le
126	    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (d : ℕ)
127	    (h : ∀ z : X, Module.finrank (ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk z))
128	      (CotangentSpace (X.presheaf.stalk z)) ≤ d) :
129	    topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
130	  topologicalKrullDim_le_of_forall_ringKrullDim_stalk_le X _ fun z =>
131	    le_trans (ringKrullDim_stalk_le_finrank_cotangentSpace X z)
132	      (by exact_mod_cast Nat.cast_le.mpr (h z))
133	
134	/-- **A dimension computation entirely in cotangent currency.** A uniform bound
135	`dim_κ (m_z/m_z²) ≤ d` at every point, together with **one** point `z₀` that is
136	regular and has cotangent dimension exactly `d`, gives `dim X = d`.
137	
138	The asymmetry between the two hypotheses is the mathematics, not an artefact:
139	
140	* the `≤` half is unconditional (`ringKrullDim_le_finrank_cotangentSpace`);
141	* the `≥` half needs `z₀` **regular**, since it converts an embedding dimension into
142	  a lower bound on the Krull dimension, and without regularity that is false — at a
143	  cusp the embedding dimension exceeds the dimension.
144	
145	For `Pic⁰_{C/k}` the distinguished point is the identity, where the tangent-space
146	identity of this chapter supplies `d = g(C)`. -/
147	theorem topologicalKrullDim_eq_of_forall_finrank_cotangentSpace_le_of_regular
148	    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (d : ℕ)
149	    (h : ∀ z : X, Module.finrank (ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk z))
150	      (CotangentSpace (X.presheaf.stalk z)) ≤ d)
151	    (z₀ : X) (hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk z₀))
152	    (hz₀ : Module.finrank (ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk z₀))
153	      (CotangentSpace (X.presheaf.stalk z₀)) = d) :
154	    topologicalKrullDim X = (d : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
155	  le_antisymm (topologicalKrullDim_le_of_forall_finrank_cotangentSpace_le X d h)
156	    (le_topologicalKrullDim_of_finrank_cotangentSpace X d z₀ hreg hz₀)
157	
158	end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

11	/-!
12	# The dimension of `Pic⁰_{C/k}` is the genus
13	
14	This file turns the tangent-space identity `dim_{κ(e)} m_e/m_e² = g(C)` at the
15	identity of `Pic⁰_{C/k}` (`Pic0.finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_finrank_hModuleOne`,
16	`Picard/Pic0AbelianVariety.lean`) into a statement about the **dimension of the
17	scheme** `Pic⁰_{C/k}`, which is what Milne III.1 Rmk 1.4(e) — "the dimension of
18	`J` is the genus of `C`" — asserts and what
19	`Pic0Scheme.finrank_eq_genus` (`Picard/IdentityComponent.lean`) pins.
20	
21	## Two inputs, and which of them was actually missing
22	
23	The recorded blocker at `finrank_eq_genus` was the *dimension-theoretic* step,
24	priced as an absent mathlib API for `topologicalKrullDim`. That step is supplied
25	by `Picard/SchemeKrullDimStalk.lean`, from the definition of the invariant rather
26	than from a presentation. What remains here is the *local algebra*:
27	
28	* **regularity of the stalk** at the point where the tangent space is computed
29	  — `Scheme.isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_smooth_of_perfectField` below;
30	* the **≥ direction only** comes for free from data at the identity. The ≤
31	  direction genuinely needs information at every point, and is stated as a
32	  hypothesis (see `topologicalKrullDim_eq_genus_of_forall_ringKrullDim_stalk_le`).
33	
34	## The generalisation this file contributes upstream of itself
35	
36	`Albanese/CodimOneExtension.lean` already proves stalk regularity from
37	smoothness, as `isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_smooth` — but over an
38	**algebraically closed** field, and with `[GeometricallyIrreducible]`,
39	`[IsSeparated]`, `[LocallyOfFiniteType]`, `[IsIntegral]`, `[IsReduced]` binders.
40	None of those is used by the argument: the chart step is mathlib's
41	`Smooth.exists_isStandardSmooth` (Stacks 00T7), which needs only smoothness, and
42	the algebra step is the project's own
43	`isRegularLocalRing_of_isLocalization_atPrime_of_isStandardSmooth_of_perfectField`
44	(`Albanese/SmoothPrimeRegularity.lean`), which needs only `PerfectField`. So the
45	version proved here has `[Field k] [PerfectField k] [Smooth X.hom]` and nothing
46	else.
47	
48	That matters for this lane specifically: `Pic⁰_{C/k}` lives over the *given* base
49	field `k`, not over `k̄`, and no descent step is available for regularity — so the
50	alg-closed version could not have been applied here at all. (`PerfectField` is
51	still an assumption on `k`, and a real one: it holds in characteristic zero and
52	for finite and algebraically closed fields, and fails for e.g. `𝔽_p(t)`.)
53	-/
54	
55	universe u
56	
57	open AlgebraicGeometry Order TopologicalSpace CategoryTheory Limits IsLocalRing
58	
59	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
60	
61	/-- **Stalks of a smooth scheme over a perfect field are regular local rings**
62	(Stacks 00TT, Jacobian-criterion direction) — at **every** point, closed or not,
63	with no hypothesis on the scheme beyond smoothness of the structural morphism.
64	
65	Two steps, both already in the tree:
66	
67	* mathlib's `Smooth.exists_isStandardSmooth` (Stacks 00T7) gives an affine chart
68	  `V ∋ z` on which the section ring is standard-smooth over `Γ(Spec k, U)`, and
69	  `gammaSpecField_ringEquiv` identifies that base with `k`;
70	* the stalk is the localisation of `Γ(X, V)` at the prime of `z`
71	  (`IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_stalk`), and the project's Serre-free Stacks-00TT
72	  theorem at an arbitrary prime over a perfect field,
73	  `isRegularLocalRing_of_isLocalization_atPrime_of_isStandardSmooth_of_perfectField`
74	  (`Albanese/SmoothPrimeRegularity.lean`), concludes.
75	
76	**This is a strict generalisation of `isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_smooth`**
77	(`Albanese/CodimOneExtension.lean`), which asks for `[IsAlgClosed kbar]` plus
78	`[GeometricallyIrreducible]`, `[IsSeparated]`, `[LocallyOfFiniteType]`,
79	`[IsIntegral]` and `[IsReduced]`. What is *measured* here is that the proof below
80	elaborates with all six absent simultaneously and `PerfectField` in place of
81	`IsAlgClosed` — which is the claim that matters, though it does not by itself
82	show each binder is individually unused in the original (that proof is a
83	different proof term). The alg-closedness enters the argument only through
84	`PerfectField`, which `IsAlgClosed` implies.
85	
86	The generalisation is *load-bearing* for the Picard lane, not cosmetic: `Pic⁰_{C/k}`
87	sits over the given field `k`, and regularity of a stalk does not descend along
88	`Spec k̄ → Spec k` by any route in this tree, so the alg-closed form is unusable
89	here. -/
90	theorem isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_smooth_of_perfectField
91	    {k : Type u} [Field k] [PerfectField k]
92	    (X : Over (Spec (.of k)))
93	    [Smooth X.hom]
94	    (z : X.left) :
95	    IsRegularLocalRing (X.left.presheaf.stalk z) := by
96	  obtain ⟨U, hU, V, hV, hzV, e, hSS⟩ :=
97	    AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth.exists_isStandardSmooth X.hom z
98	  -- Base identification `Γ(Spec k, U) ≃+* k`: `U` contains the image of `z`, so it
99	  -- is nonempty.
100	  let ε : k ≃+* Γ(Spec (.of k), U) :=
101	    (gammaSpecField_ringEquiv k U ⟨⟨_, e hzV⟩⟩).symm
102	  have hSS' : ((X.hom.appLE U V e).hom.comp ε.toRingHom).IsStandardSmooth :=
103	    RingHom.isStandardSmooth_respectsIso.2 _ ε hSS
104	  letI : Algebra k Γ(X.left, V) :=
105	    ((X.hom.appLE U V e).hom.comp ε.toRingHom).toAlgebra
106	  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth k Γ(X.left, V) := hSS'.toAlgebra
107	  letI : Algebra Γ(X.left, V) (X.left.presheaf.stalk z) :=
108	    TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.left.presheaf ⟨z, hzV⟩
109	  haveI hLoc : IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.left.presheaf.stalk z)
110	      (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨z, hzV⟩).asIdeal :=
111	    hV.isLocalization_stalk ⟨z, hzV⟩
112	  have hp : (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨z, hzV⟩).asIdeal.IsPrime := (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨z, hzV⟩).isPrime
113	  haveI : Nontrivial Γ(X.left, V) := by
114	    refine ⟨0, 1, fun h => hp.1 ?_⟩
115	    exact Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ (Submodule.zero_mem _) (h ▸ isUnit_one)
116	  letI : Algebra k (X.left.presheaf.stalk z) :=
117	    ((algebraMap Γ(X.left, V) (X.left.presheaf.stalk z)).comp
118	      (algebraMap k Γ(X.left, V))).toAlgebra
119	  haveI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X.left, V) (X.left.presheaf.stalk z) :=
120	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
121	  exact isRegularLocalRing_of_isLocalization_atPrime_of_isStandardSmooth_of_perfectField
122	    (k := k) (S := Γ(X.left, V)) _ hp (X.left.presheaf.stalk z)
123	
124	namespace Pic0
125	
126	/-- **`Pic⁰_{C/k}` is locally Noetherian** — free from finite type over a field,
127	via `Pic0.locallyOfFiniteType` and mathlib's
128	`LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian`.
129	
130	**NOT needed by anything in this file**, and worth saying so where a reader will
131	look. It was written to discharge an `[IsLocallyNoetherian X]` binder on
132	`Scheme.le_topologicalKrullDim_of_finrank_cotangentSpace`, and that binder was
133	dead: `class IsRegularLocalRing R extends IsLocalRing R, IsNoetherianRing R`, so
134	the regularity hypothesis sitting beside it already supplied the Noetherian
135	instance. The binder is gone and this helper no longer has a consumer here.
136	
137	Kept rather than deleted because the statement is true, cheap, and the natural
138	thing for a *later* consumer to want — `IsLocallyNoetherian` is the hypothesis of
139	mathlib's Noetherian-scheme API, and the `≤` half of the dimension statement
140	(still open, see below) is likely to need it where no regularity hypothesis is in
141	scope. Do not read its presence as evidence that it is used. -/
142	theorem isLocallyNoetherian {k : Type u} [Field k]
143	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
144	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
145	    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] [HasPicScheme C]
146	    [PicScheme.PicSchemeLocallyOfFiniteType C] :
147	    IsLocallyNoetherian (Pic0Scheme C).left := by
148	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (Pic0Scheme C).hom := Pic0.locallyOfFiniteType C
149	  exact LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (Pic0Scheme C).hom
150	
151	/-- **The genus is a LOWER bound for the dimension of `Pic⁰_{C/k}`** — a
152	*reduction*, not an axiom-clean theorem: see the measurement note below.
153	
154	**MEASURED (`#print axioms`, full-root import): this reports `sorryAx`.** It
155	consumes `Pic0.finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_finrank_hModuleOne`, which is gated on
156	the open cocycle comparison
157	`Pic0.semilinearComparison_cotangentSpaceDual_h1Cok`
158	(`Picard/Pic0AbelianVariety.lean:805`, front (a) of this chapter). So the honest
159	reading is: the dimension inequality needs **nothing beyond** the tangent-space
160	identity plus regularity at one point — no new geometry, no quantifier over
161	points — but the tangent-space identity is itself not yet closed. Everything in
162	`Picard/SchemeKrullDimStalk.lean` that this rests on *is* axiom-clean; the leak is
163	inherited from front (a) alone.
164	
165	This is the half of Milne III.1 Rmk 1.4(e) that the tangent-space computation
166	gives away for free, and it needs data at **one** point:
167	
168	* `Pic0.finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_finrank_hModuleOne` computes
169	  `dim_{κ(e)} m_e/m_e² = dim_k H¹(C, 𝒪_C) = g(C)` at the identity;
170	* at a regular point `IsRegularLocalRing.iff_finrank_cotangentSpace` turns that
171	  into `dim 𝒪_{Pic⁰, e} = g(C)`;
172	* and a stalk's dimension is at most the dimension of the scheme
173	  (`ringKrullDim_stalk_le_topologicalKrullDim`, from
174	  `Picard/SchemeKrullDimStalk.lean`).
175	
176	Note what is *not* needed: no quantifier over the points of `Pic⁰`, no smoothness
177	of `Pic⁰` (only regularity at `e`), and no affine-local presentation — the
178	recorded route through `Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension` is not
179	taken. -/
180	theorem genus_le_topologicalKrullDim_of_isRegular {k : Type u} [Field k]
181	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
182	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
183	    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] [HasPicScheme C]
184	    [PicScheme.PicSchemeLocallyOfFiniteType C]
185	    (hreg : IsRegularLocalRing ((Pic0Scheme C).left.presheaf.stalk
186	      ((identitySection C).base default))) :
187	    ((AlgebraicGeometry.genus C : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)
188	      ≤ topologicalKrullDim (Pic0Scheme C).left :=
189	  le_topologicalKrullDim_of_finrank_cotangentSpace _ _ _ hreg
190	    (finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_finrank_hModuleOne C)
191	
192	/-- **The genus lower bound, with regularity discharged from smoothness over a
193	perfect field.**
194	
195	`Pic⁰_{C/k}` smooth over `k` (which is what `Pic0.smooth` asserts, and what
196	`Pic0.smooth_of_isReduced_algebraicClosureBaseChange` reduces to reducedness over
197	`k̄`) gives regularity of *every* stalk by

bounds the scheme's dimension from below.**

`dim_{κ(z)} m_z/m_z²` with `dim 𝒪_{X,z}`, and that is at most `dim X` by

that backwards: it carried `[IsLocallyNoetherian X]` and explained it as "what
